## What

Restores the two alt-card microinteractions PR #46 deliberately skipped ("mapping decision #5") — the coolest parts of the mockup (`#sess-s1-alt`, DESIGN-SPEC §6):

Settled sessions (summary + prompt + ≥1 obs) get a **Replay** button in the head row. Clicking it re-runs the session lifecycle **on that session's real data**: the head cross-fades to the lilac prompt face, the rail opens on the dashed "listening" placeholder with the Recording pill, then the real observations land one-by-one on the ruler + strip (~950ms cadence, `tcDotLand`/`tcCardLand` + scroll-to-newest + flash via the same `rail.landObs` pipeline live sessions use), the "distilling N observations…" pill takes over, and the card cross-fade-settles back onto the butter summary face. Any dot/card/seg/stack interaction stops the run instantly and lands where you clicked. Reduced motion settles instantly. No loop — one run per click.

### ✦ distill — per-kind synthesis panel
Hovering (or focusing) a type stack on the summary face reveals the sparkle button (the `data-stack`/`data-magic` reveal CSS that shipped unused in `viewer.css` now lights up; always visible on touch).
